title: Bridge battery level confusion
symptom: When using the wear based collection service, the xbridge battery status appears to be confused with the watch battery level, displaying both as the same level even when they are not. This was not seen in the previous version.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state the root cause, but it is implied that the wear collection service incorrectly reports the bridge battery level as the watch battery level.
fix: A patch was provided by kskandispersonal and resolved in the 25th April nightly. The user confirmed that after installing the update, it appears to be working properly.
evidence_quote: What seems to happen is that when the watch is doing the collecting, it displays both the watch and xbridge battery as the same level even when I know they are not the same
